title: Kill all processes using a TCP port
summary: Forcefully terminate all processes that have a TCP connection on a specific port. Useful for clearing a port that is stuck or blocked by a zombie process.

steps.explain: Send the SIGKILL signal to all processes with a TCP connection on the specified port.

placeholders.name: PORT
placeholders.description: The TCP port number whose users should be killed

warnings: This forcefully kills network services or applications using the port.
Ensure you are not killing a critical system service or your own remote session.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for killing processes. You must restart the affected services or applications manually.
